stem: Which group reports the lowest rate of condom use according to the survey slides?
explanation: The speaker notes that condom use is lowest among older female adolescents who often prefer other contraceptive methods.
rationale: This group is also the one most likely to be in longer-lasting romantic relationships and using the pill.

optionExplanations.A: The red and black lines (representing Year $10$ students) actually show the highest condom use.
optionExplanations.B: The speaker notes that condom use is lowest among older female adolescents who often prefer other contraceptive methods.
optionExplanations.C: Younger adolescents generally have higher rates of barrier method use compared to the Year $12$ female cohort.
optionExplanations.D: While use may be low in young adulthood, the specific survey data highlighted focuses on Year $10$ and Year $12$ students.

source.hint: This group is also the one most likely to be in longer-lasting romantic relationships and using the pill.
